name: Windows health check
description: Read-only OS, uptime, memory, disk capacity, Defender, reboot indicators, and stopped automatic service report. Failed sections report unavailable; collection status is not a health verdict.

name: Windows temporary file cleanup
description: Preview or delete old files directly inside Windows Temp. Skips subdirectories and reparse points. Defaults to preview and a seven-day minimum age. Reports candidate and deleted bytes and file counts.

name: Windows service management
description: Show status, start, stop, or restart one exact Windows service name. Defaults to status. Does not force dependent services to stop or change startup configuration.
